sources.title: TinyPine AI Studio — local image generation that just works
sources.snippet: TinyPine keeps the stable part — the inference engine — and wraps it in a thin app that owns its own runtime, picks the right model for your hardware, and gives feedback on everything.

sources.title: pinecoresystems/Krea-2-Raw · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Krea 2 Raw (ungated mirror) Ungated mirror of krea/Krea-2-Raw, republished by TinyPine so it can be downloaded without a Hub gate. The weights are unmodified, byte for byte those of the source repository; verify by comparing each file's sha256 against the source's LFS oid. Contents: the transformer/ folder only. RAW shares its text encoder, tokenizer, scheduler and VAE with Krea 2 Turbo ...
